modules.title: Speech Production
modules.topics: Speech Production :- Acoustic theory of speech production; Source/Filter model - Pitch, Formant; Spectrogram- Wide and narrow band spectrogram; Discrete model for speech production; Short-Time Speech Analysis; Windowing; STFT; Time domain parameters (Short time energy, short time zero crossing Rate, ACF); Frequency domain parameters - Filter bank analysis; STFT Analysis.

modules.title: Mel-frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC)- Computation
modules.topics: Mel-frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC)- Computation; Pitch Estimation ACF/AMDF approaches; Cepstral analysis - Pitch and Formant estimation using cepstral analysis; LPC Analysis - LPC model; Auto correlation method - Levinson Durbin Algorithm

modules.title: Speech Enhancement
modules.topics: Speech Enhancement :- Spectral subtraction and Filtering, Harmonic filtering, Parametric resynthesis; Speech coding - fundamentals, class of coders : Time domain/spectral domain/vocoders, Sub band coding, adaptive transform coding, phase vocoder; Speaker Recognition :- Speaker verification and speaker identification, log-likelihood; Language identification - Implicit and explicit models; Machine learning models in Speaker Recognition.

modules.title: Signal Processing models of audio perception - Basic anatomy
modules.topics: Signal Processing models of audio perception - Basic anatomy of hearing System, Basilar membrane behaviour; Sound perception - Auditory Filter Banks, Critical Band Structure, Absolute Threshold of Hearing; Masking - Simultaneous Masking, Temporal Masking; Models of speech perception.
